thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning to gate the cluster keystore rollout with RBAC and audit hooks for the base-image rebuild next week. Need owners for policy + logging.
aj: I can take RBAC policy changes. Do we want the keystore operator restricted to a single svc account or a small group?
kyle: single svc account sounds safer. We should add a short-lived jump role for emergency ops (duration 30m) backed by OIDC aud.
sean: Agree on single svc account. For audit, we need KMS envelope logs forwarded to the central audit cluster + syscall-level container events from runtime.
maria: @sean can you outline the required log fields so we can update the audit forwarding config? e.g., key_id, operation, requester, nonce, pod_name.
sean: Sure. Minimal fields: key_id, envelope_id, operation(create|decrypt|sign), requester_principal, request_ts, pod_uid, image_digest, node_id, k8s_namespace. Also include request_headers if present.
security-bot: Reminder: any KMS access must be recorded in the keystore audit table and replicated to the s3-audit-bucket. Retention 365d per compliance.
aj: For RBAC, proposed role bindings:

```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-operator
rules:
- apiGroups: ["keystore.redwood.ai"]
  resources: ["keys","envelopes"]
  verbs: ["get","create","update"]
```

and a ClusterRoleBinding to svc-account:keystore-operator@infra.
kyle: Also add constraint: key creation requires annotation "redwood:can-rotate=true" on the issuing namespace. That prevents accidental admin creds being wrapped.
maria: Good. Ops question — during the rebuild we might need to re-sign layers. Do we rotate the keystore or reuse existing signer keys? Impact on image provenance?
sean: Prefer not to rotate primary signing key during the rebuild window. If we must, we'll do a staged rotation: generate new key, sign a small canary image, verify signatures in verification pipeline, then bulk sign. That preserves provenance continuity.
aj: Noted. I'll put RBAC patches in a PR targeting the staging cluster by EOD. Need review from security and ops.
kyle: I'll draft the canary signing playbook and the emergency rollback steps (how to fall back to old signatures if verification fails).
security-bot: Action item recorded: KEYS-248: RBAC + audit for keystore. Owner: aj. Due: 2026-04-01.
ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-04-03 02:00-06:00 UTC. Will open change ticket and seq runbook.
maria: Thanks all. Quick checklist before we close:
- aj: PR for RBAC -> staging
- sean: audit field spec + fluentd parser update
- kyle: canary signing playbook + rollback
- ops: change ticket + runway
please ping this thread when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
aj: pinged with PR link in #eng-infra once ready.
kyle: will post playbook draft here later today.
sean: uploading audit schema to /docs/audit/keystore-schema.yml and will link it in the PR.
maria: perfect. If we hit any blocker during staging validation, we do not promote. :no_entry_sign:
sean: acknowledged. will run a quick destructive test in sandbox tomorrow to validate logs are captured.
maria: alright closing from my side. thanks everyone!
